fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects usage of the 'crontab' utility to remove the current crontab.
This is a common occurrence where cryptocurrency miners compete against each other by removing traces of other miners to hijack the maximum amount of resources possible
fields.name: Remove Scheduled Cron Task/Job
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "crontab" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -r"))
